name: en-core
description: English business correspondence. Every name, address, number and identifier here is invented. Vendor-prefixed API keys are deliberately absent: a literal one in a shipped data file trips the secret scanners of everyone who clones the repository. Labels mark what a competent human redactor would remove, which for personal names includes many that the anchored rules cannot reach -- that gap is the point of measuring.

samples.annotated:
Dear [[PERSON:Jane Doe]],

Thanks for your note. I will follow up on Friday.
Mr. [[PERSON:John Smith]] will attend on behalf of [[COMPANY_NAME:Acme Inc.]]
samples.note: Title-anchored name; the title itself is not part of the value.

samples.annotated:
Hi [[PERSON:Sarah]],
please review the attached before Thursday.

Thanks for your help.

Regards,
[[PERSON:Michael Chen]]
samples.note: Sign-off anchored.

samples.annotated:
Full name: [[PERSON:Priya Raman]]
Department: Engineering
I spoke to [[PERSON:Jane Doe]] about the migration yesterday.
samples.note: Known gap: an unanchored name. Expected to leak until the model tier lands.

samples.annotated: The Quarterly Business Review is scheduled for Monday.
samples.note: Negative: capitalised phrase, not a name.

samples.annotated: Monday works for me. Tuesday does not.
samples.note: Negative: sentence openers.

samples.annotated: Reach me at [[EMAIL:jane.doe@example.com]] or [[PHONE:(415) 555-0198]].
Call [[PHONE:415-555-0198]] before noon.
samples.note: NANP with hyphens.

samples.annotated: Order [[?PHONE:4155550198]] shipped this morning.
samples.note: Ten bare digits are an order number to the anchored rules and a possible phone number to the wide ones. Tolerated.

samples.annotated: International line: [[PHONE:+1 415 555 0198]]
samples.note: E.164, matched by the universal rule.

samples.annotated: SSN [[SSN:123-45-6789]] is on file for the new hire.
Social Security Number: [[SSN:123456789]]
samples.note: Unhyphenated form behind a label.

samples.annotated: Ticket 666-45-6789 was closed last week.
samples.note: Negative: area 666 is never issued.

samples.annotated: Ship to [[ADDRESS:1600 Pennsylvania Avenue]], Washington, ZIP code: [[POSTAL_CODE:20500]]
Springfield, IL [[POSTAL_CODE:62704-1234]]
samples.note: ZIP+4 stands on its own.

samples.annotated: Part 62704 is back in stock.
samples.note: Negative: five bare digits need a label. The wide ZIP rule needs a state abbreviation in front, so this stays a true negative under both stances.

samples.annotated: Our London office is at [[POSTAL_CODE:SW1A 1AA]].
We shipped 1600 Widgets Today.
samples.note: Negative: a number followed by capitalised words is not an address.

samples.annotated: Date of birth: [[DATE_OF_BIRTH:March 4, 1985]]
Shipped on 1985-04-01 and delivered a week later.
samples.note: Negative: a shipping date is not a date of birth.

samples.annotated: Card [[CREDIT_CARD:5500005555555559]] was declined.
Reference [[?IDENTIFIER:1234567812345678]] in the ledger.
samples.note: Sixteen digits failing Luhn. Not a card; the wide tier still reads it as an identifier, which is the trade. Tolerated.

samples.annotated: The contract is with [[COMPANY_NAME:Globex Corporation]] until March.
[[COMPANY_NAME:Initech LLC]] and [[COMPANY_NAME:Umbrella Ltd]] have both signed.
The contract is with [[COMPANY_NAME:Acme]].
samples.note: Known gap: a trading name with no legal suffix.

samples.annotated: Employee ID: [[EMPLOYEE_ID:A-12345]] starts on the 3rd.
Project: [[PROJECT_NAME:Nightingale]] is on track for Q3.
Runbook: [[INTERNAL_URL:https://wiki.corp.local/runbook]]
Docs are at https://example.com/docs for anyone who needs them.
samples.note: Negative: a public URL.

samples.annotated: The staging box is [[INTERNAL_IP:10.0.4.17]]; production is behind the LB.
Resolver is 8.8.8.8 in that environment.
samples.note: Negative: a public IP.

Dear [[PERSON:Mary Smith-Jones]],

samples.annotated: Attn: [[PERSON:Robert Lang]] -- invoice attached.
Please confirm receipt by end of day. Thanks.
samples.note: Negative: an entire message with nothing to protect.

samples.annotated:
Dear [[PERSON:Jane Doe]],

CC [[EMAIL:john.smith@example.org]] and [[EMAIL:ops@example.org]].

Regards,
[[PERSON:Michael Chen]]

samples.annotated: Dr. [[PERSON:Alan Turing]] reviewed the draft.
samples.note: Title-anchored, two words.

samples.annotated: Contact: [[PERSON:Yuki Tanaka]] (Tokyo office)
samples.note: Label-anchored, romanised Japanese name.

samples.annotated: Revenue was up 12% year on year; headcount is unchanged.
samples.note: Negative for v0.1: business-sensitive in context, which is not modelled.

samples.annotated: Ping [[EMAIL:a.b+tag@mail.corp.example.co.uk]] if the build breaks.
Retry step 2 after error_404 on line 17.
samples.note: Negative: placeholder-shaped noise that must not be mistaken for one.

samples.annotated:
Hello [[PERSON:Tom]],

the invoice for [[COMPANY_NAME:Acme Inc.]] is attached. Employee ID: [[EMPLOYEE_ID:C-4477]].

Dear [[PERSON:Priya Raman]],

[[PERSON:Priya Raman]] is leading the migration. Please loop [[PERSON:Priya Raman]] in.
samples.note: Co-occurrence: the salutation settles the first mention, and nothing marks the other two.

samples.annotated:
Mr. [[PERSON:John Smith]] called.
[[PERSON:John Smith]] wants the report by Friday.
samples.note: Co-occurrence across lines from a title anchor.

samples.annotated:
Dear [[PERSON:Ann]],

the announcement goes out Monday. Announcements are drafted already.
samples.note: Propagation must respect word boundaries: Ann is a seed, Announcement is not an occurrence of it.

samples.annotated:
Dear [[PERSON:Jane Doe]],

please confirm by Friday.
samples.note: Single mention: propagation must not invent extra occurrences.
A password written in prose. Added in 0.12 after `mamori audit` reported that the rule for it, shipped in 0.10, had never fired on any sample.
samples.annotated: The staging password is [[PASSWORD:hunter2spring]], can you check the deploy?

samples.note: Negative: talking about a password is not disclosing one. Blocking this would stop a request over an ordinary sentence, which is the most disruptive false positive this library can produce.
samples.annotated: My password is fine, I just cannot reach the gateway.

samples.note: A UK-style number: leading zero, space separated. en.PHONE.2 existed for this and had no sample until 0.12.
samples.annotated: Reach the London office on [[PHONE:020 7946 0958]].

samples.note: An address with the @ held apart by spaces. Not a valid address and a perfectly ordinary way for one to appear: a line wrapped, a word processor tidying up, somebody spacing it out on purpose.
samples.annotated: Reach me at [[EMAIL:jane.doe @ example.com]] before Friday.
